title: Why Regular Dental Cleanings Matter: Health, Cost & How Often to Come
seoTitle: Dental Cleanings in Valencia: Why and How Often
seoDescription: Regular cleanings remove tartar, protect your gums and catch problems early, saving money over time. See how often to come and book in Valencia.
excerpt: Why professional cleanings matter for your gums, teeth and wallet, what happens during a visit, and how often to come based on your risk level.
keyTakeaways: Cleanings remove tartar that brushing cannot, help reverse early gum disease, and protect crowns and implants.
Preventive visits cost far less than the root canals, crowns or periodontal surgery that untreated problems can lead to.
Low-risk adults: every 6 months; moderate risk: every 4 months; periodontal maintenance or implants: every 2 to 3 months.
A cleaning includes gum screening, scaling, polishing, fluoride when indicated and home-care coaching.
Most dental plans cover at least one preventive cleaning every six months; the office can pre-verify benefits.
